title: アグネスタキオン登場！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At long last, Agnes Tachyon and I are about to take on the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It begins today! We're meeting to have a discussion about our future prospects and goals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …Or at least, that was the plan.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Guinea p—Trainer, you're awake, I see!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I come to my senses, and find myself standing on a racetrack beneath a clear blue sky.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Relax, you're in a virtual dimension. In other words, this is a VR experience. I took a commercial product and tweaked it a tiny bit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I was so impressed that I didn't even notice the weight of the headset. I begin to take it off, when…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hold up, hold up, stop your uncouth behavior! I'll have you know my entire career as a researcher hinges on this experiment!
choice_data_list: Wh-what do you mean by experiment?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I'm glad you asked. You see, the more proficient an athlete the more advanced their latent cerebral functions are, generally speaking. By the same token, Umamusume are no exception.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: If the average homo sapiens sapiens like yourself were to, for example, acquire a body equivalent to that of an Umamusume, to what extent would your cerebral functions acclimate to the Umamusume body?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: My aim is to quantify the differences between the physical and cerebral functions of Umamusume, and then utilize those findings for future inventions. This is but the test run.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Long story short, I will have you do a partner run with me here in this virtual dimension. Doesn't that sound exciting?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Come now, this marks the first day of our Twinkle Series. Let's put in some effort!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She promptly puts my headset back on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This was supposed to be our first day working together to take on the Twinkle Series…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But now it's looking like I'll be wrapped up in Agnes Tachyon's latest experiment.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All of a sudden, I find myself at the starting position.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Within the boundaries of this virtual dimension, you have access to an Umamusume body which your brain can control. This way, I can monitor your latent cerebral functions.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: All you have to do is run the same way you always do. Fixate your mind on the act of running, and the rest will come naturally.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: It may not seem natural at first, but you'll get the hang of it the longer you run. So just relax, okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It appears I have no choice. The once familiar racetrack now looks like an entirely different beast.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Let me explain. Within this virtual dimension, I am almost entirely my true self.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: This virtual body reflects the physical capabilities of my real one, but make no mistake—my brain is the one in control.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: So you can consider this a bona fide partner run between us.
choice_data_list: (I can't believe I'm really going to race against Agnes Tachyon…)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Let's see, the EMG and ECG devices are recording. Heart rate and respiration are being measured. Excellent! Excellent!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: All right. What matters here is that you give it your one-hundred percent. Try and catch me!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Listen to my words carefully. You are to try and catch me.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: At any rate, we are short on time! If that school bell rings, it's going to be a real hassle!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Now… let the testing commence!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As soon as the words leave her mouth, Agnes Tachyon breaks into a dash.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her speed seems to miraculously leave behind traces of dust, her breath, her heartbeats, even light, sound, and color!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Said to have a top speed of around seventy kilometers per hour, the sight of an Umamusume at full throttle is simply breathtaking.
choice_data_list: (There's no way my human body can keep up!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I stand there gawking at her distant figure—the one that was standing side by side with me just seconds ago.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She relentlessly speeds further and further away. I run after her in an effort to catch up, but the distance doesn't shrink at all.
choice_data_list: (I'm also using an Umamusume body, but she's on a whole different level!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Huff… puff… huff!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon may be a problem child obsessed with her research, but her raw talent is undeniably one of a kind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her need for speed is genuine, and she never stops striving to reach new top speeds.
choice_data_list: (See, you can do it if you try!)
(See, you can do it if you try!)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hey! You finally made it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even this far away, I feel like I can hear Agnes Tachyon's smug remark.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: So, how do you feel?
choice_data_list: I was reminded of how fast you are!
I was reminded of how fast you are!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Please, that's common knowledge! Any other observations? How did the run feel?
choice_data_list: I think I finally understand why you pursue the potential of Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh, is that so? The run must have been a real eye-opener for you then!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I'm pleased that we see eye to eye! Future discussions will be easier now that we have reached this consensus. An unexpected outcome, but a favorable one.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: However, you still haven't given me a proper answer. Ah, right, allow me to rephrase the question.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Does it hurt anywhere? How fatigued do you feel?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After running at a speed I never could before, my body is still reeling from the resulting headache and dizziness.
choice_data_list: I might topple over at any moment.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh, is that so? How utterly fascinating! I see, I see!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After a short bout of excitement, Agnes Tachyon waves goodbye, seemingly satisfied with the collected data.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Thank you for your cooperation with today's experiment. Now, if you'll excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just like that, she turns on her heel and walks off. Once I lose sight of her, I turn around and start heading back to my office.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I remember we're supposed to be having a meeting.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What is it now? I'm in the middle of something.
choice_data_list: We have to continue our discussion!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: …Oh, you remembered.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Let us postpone the meeting for tomorrow! As of this moment, I have important things to attend to.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I can join you tomorrow if circumstances allow. If it turns out I cannot, well…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: No need to get so worked up. Besides, even if I were to promise to attend…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: There's no guarantee that you would be able to come, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next day…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: True to her ominous word, a persistent, acute dizziness prevents me from taking even one step outside.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: As a trainer, having the chance to experience the wonders and mystery behind Umamusume-kind is worth any sacrifice, wouldn't you agree?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She spares just five minutes of her time for a visit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Either way, my days exploring the limits of Umamusume potential with Agnes Tachyon have begun!
